# `:desktop:swing` — JVM Desktop Swing / AWT Backend

## Overview
`:desktop:swing` is the cross-platform JVM desktop backend (`jvmMain`) for GenericUI, built on Java Swing (`javax.swing.*`) and AWT (`java.awt.*`). It depends on `:common`, `:systemCommon`, and `:desktop:common`.

---

## Single-`commonMain` Architecture & `SwingLauncher`

The GenericUI Gradle plugin (`GenericUiGenerateLaunchersTask`) automatically generates a `jvmMain` entry point (`@file:JvmName("GeneratedSwingMain")`) that delegates to `SwingLauncher`:

```kotlin
// Auto-generated by GenericUiGenerateLaunchersTask in build/generated/genericui/launchers/jvmMain
@file:JvmName("GeneratedSwingMain")
package com.example.app

import com.nexustools.genericui.swing.SwingLauncher

fun main(args: Array<String>) {
    SwingLauncher.launch(
        args = args,
        title = "My App",
        width = 1280,
        height = 800,
        mainFragmentFactory = { MyMainFragment() }
    )
}
```

`SwingLauncher` (`com.nexustools.genericui.swing.SwingLauncher`) ensures `SwingNativeBootstrap.ensureInstalled()` is called on the AWT Event Dispatch Thread (`SwingUtilities.invokeLater`), creates the primary `JFrame` via `SwingNativeWindowHost`, mounts the root `FragmentHostFragment`, and makes the window visible. Launching another `@AppFragment` via `AppFragmentLauncher` opens a new `JFrame` with its own `FragmentHostFragment`.

---

## Window Chrome, `TitleCapabilities`, & Single-Placement `TitleBar`

`SwingWindowImpl` reports native desktop `TitleCapabilities` (`isTitleBarRequired = true`, `supportsCustomComponents = true`, `canEmbedComponentsInTitleBar = true`, `titleBarRendersAsNavbar = false`):
- **Single-Placement `TitleBar`**: When custom leading, center, or trailing components are added to `TitleBar`, `SwingWindowImpl` marks them with `mountedInTitleBar = true` and `SwingNativeWindowHost` mounts their underlying `JComponent` instances inside the custom header bar panel at the top of the `JFrame`, filtering them out of the main content `JPanel` so they never render twice.
- **`JMenuBar` & StatusBar**: `MenuBar` maps directly to `JFrame.setJMenuBar(JMenuBar)`, and `StatusBar` mounts at `BorderLayout.SOUTH`.

---

## JAR Classpath Resources (`SwingResourceResolverImpl`)

During the Gradle build, `GenericUiCompileResourcesTask` packages `src/commonMain/resources/` into the JVM classpath / fat JAR along with compiled resource metadata tables.

At runtime, `SwingResourceResolverImpl` (`com.nexustools.genericui.swing.system.SwingResourceResolverImpl`) resolves assets using `Thread.currentThread().contextClassLoader.getResource(...)` and `getResourceAsStream(...)`, returning `jar:file:...` / `file:...` URLs, localized strings, colors, dimensions, AWT `Font` instances, and raw byte arrays.

---

## Key Package Structure (`com.nexustools.genericui.swing`)

- **`SwingLauncher.kt` / `SwingNativeBootstrap.kt` / `SwingNativeWindowHost.kt`**: EDT bootstrap, `JFrame` lifecycle, custom titlebar header panel, and multi-window `AppFragmentLauncher`.
- **`widget/*` & `container/*`**: Native Swing `JComponent` implementations (`JButton`, `JLabel`, `JTextField`, `JTextArea`, `JComboBox`, `JSlider`, `JProgressBar`, `JSplitPane`, `JTabbedPane`, `JScrollPane`, `JTree`, `JTable`).
- **`system/*`**: `SwingResourceResolverImpl` (`ClassLoader`), `SwingPreferenceStoreImpl` (`java.util.prefs.Preferences` / file-backed store), `SwingClipboardImpl` (`Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().systemClipboard`), `SwingFileBrowserDialogImpl` (`JFileChooser`), `SwingSystemTrayImpl` (`java.awt.SystemTray`), and `SwingUiDispatcherImpl` (`SwingUtilities.invokeLater`).
